name: convertkit-prepopulate
description: Pre-populate ConvertKit landing page forms with subscriber data from URL parameters. Features input validation, XSS protection, and flexible configuration.

scripts.minify: cat pre-pop.js | tr -d '\n' | sed 's/  */ /g' | sed 's/ *{ */{/g' | sed 's/ *} */}/g' | sed 's/ *( */(/g' | sed 's/ *) */)/g' | sed 's/ *; */;/g' | sed 's/ *, */,/g' > pre-pop.min.js
